UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident occurring on the evening of 28SEP2026 in the Strait of Hormuz. 

UKMTO has received a third-party report of a vessel struck by a suspected unknown projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in a fire. The fire has since been extinguished and the vessel is underway. Crew are safe, there has been no reported environmental impact or damage assessment. 

Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO WARNING 148-26 - ATTACK
Report Date:02 Oct 2026
Report Time:1122 UTC
Issue Date:02 Oct 2026
Source Master
UKMTO has received a report of an incident within the Strait of Hormuz.
The Master of a tanker has reported being struck by an unknown projectile, whilst

There are no reported casualties or environmental impact.
Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report 
any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO Suspicious Activity 165-26 
UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker in the vicinity of Sohar anchorage, Oman. 
The status of crew, damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at time of report. 

Update 001:
UKMTO has reclassified this incident as an attack following confirmation that the tanker was struck by an Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV). Local authorities are assisting in the evacuation of the crew, damage assessment and environmental impact is unknown at time of update.

Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident 78NM northeast of Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia.  

The Master of a tanker has reported being attacked by an RPG from a small boat, resulting in damage to the aft port quarter. Crew are accounted for and reported safe. A complete damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at time of report.

Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident 140NM southwest of Al Mukalla, Yemen.

A Master of an LNG Tanker has reported being approached by a small skiff with seven persons onboard. The skiff fired two shots at the tanker whose armed Security Team fired two warning shots at the small skiff which forced them to alter course.

Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO has received reports from various sources of suspicious activity within the Gulf 
of Aden. Potentially indicative of Pirate Action Group Activity.
Reports describe several sightings of suspicious small craft operating in the vicinity of 
merchant vessels. One report describes a green and blue boat with two ladders and one 
hook with 9 persons onboard.
Vessels transiting the area are advised to transit with caution, follow guidance written 
in BMP MS and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.
Authorities are investigating.
